shared_elements: bird- or animal-like head in profile
incised geometric hatching/cross-hatching on a figure
justification: The most specific overlap is that both include schematically carved animal or bird-like forms with profile heads, prominent eyes, and some incised hatching used as surface detail. The main difference is that A is a flat field of many separate profile animals and repeated signs arranged in bands/registers, while B is a compact sculptural grouping of two large interlocked figures without the same register system or repeated iconographic motifs.
